evidence.detail: The concrete R322 OutgoingPacket writes fixed C2S opcode 40 followed by exactly one widget-id integer using the matching u16 Stream writer.
Exact-current dialogue lifecycle authority pairs S2C164 open-chatbox with C2S40 Continue and identifies the payload as widgetId.
The packet object contains no unrelated state or second action; its only payload is the dialogue/widget continuation target.
The concrete R322 OutgoingPacket writes fixed C2S opcode 236 and exactly three integer fields with the ground-item option payload transforms.
Exact-current outbound/world authority identifies C2S236 as ground-item option 3 with itemId/worldX/worldY.

Option 3 defaults to Take when no explicit ground action occupies that slot, but exact-current definitions also contain contextual actions; therefore the semantic name remains GroundItemOption3Packet rather than TakePacket.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 ground-item option-slot transport; no contextual action verb is asserted.
